{"reason":"Replace the medium/high fallback action with internal rebalance. The cited medium/11.5 and high/13.2 rows have sister stock and 2–3-day transfers, supporting 6,000 rebalances instead of 45,000 switches. When sister stock is absent (medium/5.3), rebalance falls back to the same supplier, preserving stockout behavior; expected cost falls and the four stockouts do not rise.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
